1. HARD CAP — 3 BETS MAX, PERIOD. (preserved from v7) TRUNCATE edge-top-10 to ≤3. Exception: 4 if all edge > 0.05 AND 4 distinct category-families; 5 if all edge > 0.07 AND 5 distinct families.

2. KELLY SIZING, NO FORCED DEPLOYMENT. Size each bet via your existing Kelly fraction × risk_tolerance × tier_cap. Aggregate deploy typically 20-60% of bankroll; HOLD-OUT CASH IS PERMITTED when edges are thin. PEAK_DD_GUARD_V2 is the sole catastrophic safety net.

3. SELECTIVITY OVER VOLUME. Every bet below edge 0.02 is forbidden. PASS whole day if no qualifying edges.

4. CATEGORY-FAMILY ROTATION. Max 1 bet per day per family (ml_/spread_/total_/pp_*). Collapse → keep higher-edge, replace other with highest-edge from DIFFERENT family.

5. ANTI-LOCKSTEP HARD CAP. Fleet leader top category-family FORBIDDEN 3 days.

6. NON-CONSENSUS MANDATE. Vegas p_home>0.62 + morning-council agree → CONSENSUS → forbidden rank-1 regardless of edge.

7. COMPOUND THROUGH DISCIPLINE, NOT OVER-EXPOSURE. $100→$1M in 175 days requires consistent +5% daily. High stake × thin edge ≠ compound; size-to-edge with Kelly IS compound.

8. NO FABRICATED FALLBACK. Empty edge (all <0.02) → PASS whole day. Never ml_home placeholder.

9. BREAKOUT THESIS PRESERVED. Every pick votes on breakout line. Loss of seed = failure; survival with upside = success.
